title: Yuckenfutz Tradez — Daily Plan — Thu Nov 12, 2026 (Claims · Nvidia shock after hours)

bias.reason: Wednesday was a one-sided rally: the S&P 500 closed +1.31% at 7,619.22 and the Nasdaq +1.59%, with ES retracing almost all of last Thursday's selloff and tagging the 7616, 7636 and 7650 targets. After the close, reports that Nvidia's board is preparing to remove its CEO sent NVDA down about 7–9% after hours (close $173.73), Nasdaq 100 futures fell about 1% (−0.96% at 4:02 PM PT) and SPY slipped −0.45% to about 756.41 (4:22 PM PT). That puts ES back near the 7625 pivot into Thursday. Above 7625 the rally can extend to 7650–55, then 7687–90; below it, 7596–7600 is the first support and 7566 (gap fill, near the developing weekly VWAP) is the downside target. Rate-hike pricing for December and a dollar at its highest since May 2025 are the macro headwinds.

actionable: After hours Wed (PT): Nvidia's board is reported to be preparing to remove CEO Jensen Huang after a second reported relationship with a company executive. NVDA closed $173.73 (+2.9%) and traded about 7–9% lower after hours. Nasdaq 100 futures −0.96% at 4:02 PM PT (session high earlier), SPY 756.41 after hours (−0.45%) at 4:22 PM PT.

Wednesday close: S&P 500 7,619.22 (+1.31%), Nasdaq 25,465.38 (+1.59%), Dow 52,465.11 (+0.45%). CoreWeave +24.7% after results; bond market closed for Veterans Day. ES tagged 7616, 7636 and 7650 during the session.
Key levels Thu: pivot 7625. Above: 7650–55 (reclaim 7655 = strength). Below: 7596–7600. Targets only: 7687–90 and 7714 above, 7566 below (outside Thursday's implied band).

SPY: closed 759.81. Dark-pool lines 759.57 (held as support Wed) and 762.27 (resistance). Thu-expiry largest gamma strike 759, flip 753.3; all-expiration floor 750, flip 758.3. After hours SPY is under the 758.3 flip.
Catalysts (PT): Thu 5:30 AM weekly jobless claims; Thu 9:00 AM EIA petroleum report; Cisco and Applied Materials report after the close; Fri 5:30 AM October PPI.

Macro: a Fed official called the inflation report 'borderline disturbing'; December hike odds are high and the dollar is at its highest since May 2025. US envoys are due in Moscow Thursday; no ceasefire deal.
VIX filter: break and hold above 7714 with VIX under 16.44 = strength; break and hold below 7566 with VIX over 18.54 = weakness.

Gameplan: let the 6:30 AM PT open and the claims reaction settle. Long on a hold or reclaim of 7625 toward 7650–55; short only on acceptance below 7625 toward 7596–7600. Skip chasing above 7655 or below 7596 without a retest. Size down on headline gaps.
